findings.headline: FDA grants accelerated approval to Ultomiris for IgA nephropathy
findings.summary: AstraZeneca announced US accelerated approval of Ultomiris (ravulizumab) to reduce proteinuria in adults with primary IgA nephropathy at risk of progression. In the I CAN Phase III interim analysis, the placebo-adjusted reduction in proteinuria was 43.4% at week 34. The approval is based on a surrogate endpoint; slower loss of kidney function has not been established, with week-106 eGFR data pending.
findings.why_it_matters: The first approved C5 inhibitor for this disease is a completed regulatory commercialization milestone, but long-term clinical benefit remains to be confirmed.
findings.trend_statement: Complement-targeted kidney treatments are advancing via accelerated approval with postapproval outcome verification.

findings.headline: Infineon and NVIDIA advance GaN power conversion for 800 VDC AI racks
findings.summary: Infineon expanded its NVIDIA collaboration on GaN high-voltage intermediate bus converters for 800 VDC AI racks. Its specified solutions cover 800 V to 50 V, 12 V and 6 V conversion with switching frequencies up to 1 MHz. This builds on work first announced in 2025. No new fleet deployment count or independently verified total energy saving was disclosed.
findings.why_it_matters: Rack power density and electrical conversion losses are bottlenecks for AI deployment; specified power-electronics architectures address those constraints.
findings.trend_statement: AI data centers are adopting specialized wide-bandgap power conversion from grid to processor.

findings.headline: Teradyne Robotics and Sereact report hundreds of deployed physical-AI robots
findings.summary: Teradyne Robotics and Sereact formalized a partnership using Sereact Cortex AI with Universal Robots arms for unstructured logistics tasks including returns, picking and sorting. They report hundreds of UR robots in dual-arm systems already shipped to live European customer sites. The partnership aims to expand through Teradyne distribution and North America.
findings.why_it_matters: Reported live commercial installations are more meaningful than a lab demo, although independent uptime, throughput and unit-economics data are not disclosed.
findings.trend_statement: Vision-language-action systems are entering operational warehouse workflows on existing industrial robot platforms.

findings.headline: Agility reports over $300M conditional Digit 5 orders and plans new support center
findings.summary: Agility Robotics reported more than $300 million in multi-year Digit 5 orders subject to contractual milestones and four new customers across automotive, consumer goods and agriculture. It plans a 50,000-square-foot Pittsburgh software, deployment and robot-service facility, adding about 35,000 square feet to its footprint. Existing Digit deployments include GXO, Schaeffler and Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada. Orders are not revenue and the facility is planned.
findings.why_it_matters: Conditional commercial orders plus service investment demonstrate an emerging humanoid fleet pipeline, while fulfillment and support economics remain open.
findings.trend_statement: Humanoid robotics is shifting toward contracted deployments and lifecycle service infrastructure.
